nodes.label: Tendril - Prepaid Compute Marketplace on Stellar
nodes.rationale: Agent-first take on Akash/io.net for individuals: prepaid native-XLM balance topped up once, hourly prorated SSH sessions billed once at lease end, contributor paid on-chain — no per-action signing, no x402.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Docker Sandbox Trust Model
nodes.rationale: Safety boundary is an ephemeral Docker container, not a permissions system: no host filesystem mounts, no inbound host ports (sandbox dials out via bore), --cap-drop ALL + no-new-privileges, cgroup CPU/memory/PID caps, destroyed when the paid lease ends. Same containerization trade-off the DePIN compute sector runs on.

nodes.label: Contributor Agent Daemon
nodes.rationale: Proves node ownership by signing a nonce, heartbeats over WebSocket, and per lease spins up a hardened Docker SSH sandbox exposed via a bore tunnel, torn down at lease end.

nodes.label: Tendril Web App (Vite + React SPA)
nodes.rationale: Uses Vite (not Next.js) deliberately: the wallet stack (@creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit, Freighter/xBull) is client-only, so a static SPA avoids SSR/hydration friction; also why it is not dockerized — it builds to static web/dist.

nodes.label: Prepaid Custodial XLM Balance Model
nodes.rationale: Top-ups pool at one platform address; balances are an off-chain ledger in Neon so renting spends without signing (no per-rent popup). Top-ups are confirmed on-chain via Horizon and recorded by txid (idempotent). Native XLM only, so no trustline or asset opt-in is needed. Trade-off: custodial, and no on-chain renter withdrawal path yet.

nodes.label: Prorated Bill-Once-at-Lease-End Billing
nodes.rationale: Usage is calculated continuously but charged once at lease end (elapsed/3600 x hourly rate) in a single charges row — no per-tick debits, which keeps heartbeats and the watchdog from ever writing to Postgres. Worst-case over-use is one METER_INTERVAL_MS tick before teardown. Contributor is then paid on-chain minus PLATFORM_FEE_PCT.

nodes.label: GET /explorer (free node discovery endpoint)
nodes.rationale: Free so an autonomous agent can survey live nodes (specs + price) and choose by itself before spending anything.

nodes.label: POST /rent/:nodeId (prepaid metered session endpoint)
nodes.rationale: Starts an hourly-metered session against the prepaid balance with no per-rent signing; auto-stops when the balance runs out so an agent burns money only for compute actually used.

nodes.label: Wallet Sign-in Session Token (signed login nonce)
nodes.rationale: Spending the balance (rent, top-up, wallet read) requires a session token minted only after the user signs a login nonce, so nobody can spend someone else's balance.
